caption: The drawing depicts a crucifix with a figure of a man nailed to a wooden cross. The cross is brown and has a sign at the top with the letters "INRI" and another sign below it with the word "SEÑOR." The figure is shown with a crown of thorns, dark hair, and a beard. The skin of the figure is a pale tan color, and there are multiple red marks and wounds distributed across the body, arms, and legs, as well as blood marks on the hands, feet, and side. The figure is wearing a dark, almost black, loincloth that features a cross symbol. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a handwritten signature in the lower right that reads, "Hazel C. Chaplin - Taos, N.M." The drawing appears to be rendered with visible brushstrokes and simple detailing.
title: Painted Wooden Crucifix
